purpose: A financially coherent salaried professional with everything the analysis needs: stable income, essential spending well below income, easy-access savings above the emergency target, a regular monthly investment, a full questionnaire and three realistic goals. The application takes it through the whole pipeline to an approved recommendation with a portfolio, a compliance pass and an explanation -- every one of those results is computed, none is stored here.
